The '''1756 [[FLLA]] World Cup''' was the 22nd edition of the [[FLLA World Cup]], the quadrennial international [[Arraby]] tournament contested by the senior men's national teams of the member associations of the [[FLLA]]. It was held jointly by [[Erkizil]], [[Quidic]], [[Wundry]] and [[Ztesh]], and was the first FLLA World Cup ever staged in [[Quia]].

The four-nation co-hosting arrangement was a novelty in FLLA World Cup history, adopted by the [[FLLA]] Council on 7 March 1751 to support the [[QUFVL]]'s collective bid following separate proposals from each of the four associations. The participating sides contested 64 matches across venues in all four host countries.

[[Quidic]] won the tournament, defeating [[New Misos]] 1–0 in the final to claim their first FLLA World Cup title. As reigning champions, Quidic qualified automatically for the subsequent [[1760 FLLA World Cup|1760 edition]] under the FLLA's defending-champion exemption then in force.
